summary: This is an async function decorated as a Dagger pipeline step that accepts source code and returns a message indicating it will lint that source. The function doesn't actually run Pylint yet—it just returns a formatted string with ANSI color codes to display a yellow message in the terminal.

explanations.1: The @function decorator registers this method as a step in a Dagger pipeline, making it available as part of a CI/CD workflow.
explanations.2: The 'async' keyword means this function can pause and resume, allowing other tasks to run while it waits—useful for long-running operations like linting.
explanations.6: The \033[33m and \033[0m are ANSI escape codes that tell the terminal to print the message in yellow and then reset the color back to normal.
